tests.title: Member places a bank transfer order with store pickup
tests.goal: A logged-in member can place an order paid by Bank Transfer and it appears in My Orders and the CRM.
preconditions: User approval to create one staging order
data: An in-stock product found at runtime
Shipping: Hong Kong, 門市自取, first listed pickup store
Payment: Bank Transfer - 3 Work Days only

steps.text: Log in to the eShop as the QA member
Add an in-stock product and open checkout
Check Your Details are pre-filled with the member data
Choose 門市自取 and a pickup store, enter a QA address and remark
Select Bank Transfer, tick 結帳前同意, dismiss any notification prompt
Click Proceed to checkout
Open My Account > My Orders
In the CRM search Orders by the order number

expected.text: Thank-you page shows "YOUR ORDER NO.: TXN..." and the cart badge is 0
My Orders lists the order as Pending Payment
CRM order shows Pending Payment, Bank Transfer, the same items, quantities and total, delivery method 門市自取 and the remark

checks.label: Thank-you page shows "YOUR ORDER NO.: TXN..." and the cart badge is 0
My Orders lists the order as Pending Payment
CRM order shows Pending Payment, Bank Transfer, the same items, quantities and total, delivery method 門市自取 and the remark

notes: TXN0126102700002 (HKD 400, Bank Transfer, 門市自取 荔枝角): thank-you page, My Orders Pending Payment, CRM matches. Notification prompt had to be dismissed first (BUG-006).

tests.title: New member registers and can log in
tests.goal: Shoppers can create an account and sign in.

steps.text: Open /register
Fill First Name, Last Name, unique email, mobile, password twice, choose marketing No, agree to the policy
Click Register
Log in on /login with the same email and password

expected.text: "Thank you for your registration. Please check your e-mail to complete registration process." is shown and /login opens
Login shows "Login successful !" and My Account is available
The member appears in the CRM customer list with the entered name and Opt-in No

checks.label: "Thank you for your registration. Please check your e-mail to complete registration process." is shown and /login opens
Login shows "Login successful !" and My Account is available
The member appears in the CRM customer list with the entered name and Opt-in No

notes: Registered aside.member.qamvq1nfsl@example.com, logged in (login allowed before email verification).

tests.title: Registration validates policy, password length, confirmation and birthday
tests.goal: Invalid registration input is rejected with clear messages.

steps.text: Open /register and fill name and a unique email
Enter password 123 and confirmation 456, leave the policy unticked, Register
Fix the passwords, tick the policy, type birthday 02-30, Register

expected.text: Warning lists "The Agreement of Privacy policy is required.", "The Password must be at least 6 characters." and "The Password confirmation does not match."
Birthday 02-30 is rejected; no account is created with a different birthday

checks.label: Warning lists "The Agreement of Privacy policy is required.", "The Password must be at least 6 characters." and "The Password confirmation does not match."
Birthday 02-30 is rejected; no account is created with a different birthday

notes: All three warnings shown; birthday 02-30 accepted and stored as 10-27.

tests.title: Product page rejects quantity below 1 and sold-out variants
tests.goal: Customers cannot add zero/negative quantities or sold-out variants.
data: A product with at least one SOLD OUT variant, found at runtime

steps.text: Open a product page
Set quantity 0 and click Add To Cart
Set quantity -3 and click Add To Cart
Pick a variant marked SOLD OUT

expected.text: "Quantity must be greater than or equal to 1" is shown and the cart badge is unchanged for 0 and -3
For a sold-out variant the button reads SOLD OUT and nothing is added

checks.label: "Quantity must be greater than or equal to 1" is shown and the cart badge is unchanged for 0 and -3
For a sold-out variant the button reads SOLD OUT and nothing is added

notes: Qty 0 and -3 -> "Quantity must be greater than or equal to 1"; sold-out variant shows SOLD OUT.

tests.title: Promotion code: invalid code message and whole-order discount
tests.goal: Promo codes give clear feedback and correct totals.
data: Valid whole-order code read from CRM Promotions (e.g. VIP888, $20 off)

steps.text: Add a product to the cart and open checkout
Apply BADCODE999
Apply the valid code
Click REMOVE

expected.text: "Promotion code is invalid, expired or exceed the usage limit" is shown and totals do not change
With the valid code a Basket Discount line appears and Total = Sub-total minus the discount (not below 0)
After REMOVE the discount line is gone, Total equals Sub-total and the promo box is empty

checks.label: "Promotion code is invalid, expired or exceed the usage limit" is shown and totals do not change
With the valid code a Basket Discount line appears and Total = Sub-total minus the discount (not below 0)
After REMOVE the discount line is gone, Total equals Sub-total and the promo box is empty

notes: Invalid code message OK; VIP888 -HKD 20 OK; after REMOVE the promo box still shows "VIP888".
